correctness.rationale: The lens K=B(ce1,1) intersect B(-ce1,1) has sections |x1|<=1-c, |x_perp|<=sqrt(1-(|x1|+c)^2). Maximizing t(y-c)+sqrt(1-t^2)sqrt(1-y^2) over c<=y<=1 gives y=max(c,t) and stated support split. Spherical |U1| density Cn(1-t^2)^((n-3)/2) integrates to the three incomplete-beta terms; boundary derivatives cancel, leaving strictly negative derivative for 0<c<1. n=3 reduces exactly to the Finch formula; n=2 endpoint singularity is integrable. Finite scripts only supplement analytic proof.
